Messages.Author: Jeffrey Endres
Messages.Body:
What happens if a vampire equipping with vast wealth cannot afford the
equipping costs of a weapon?

eg. The first card you pull out is a loc-equip that costs two blood but
your vampire only has one...

Does the equipping action fizzle? Does the vampire equip for less blood?
(I doubt it)

If it fizzles, what happens to the card? Ash-heap or reshuffled back in
the library?

--

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Jeffrey Endres wrote:
>
> Jeffrey Endres wrote:
> >
> > What happens if a vampire equipping with vast wealth cannot afford the
> > equipping costs of a weapon?
> > eg. The first card you pull out is a loc-equip that costs two blood but
> > your vampire only has one...

The action fizzles, no blood is paid and the equipment is burned.

> > If it fizzles, what happens to the card? Ash-heap or reshuffled back in
> > the library?

Ash Heap.

> Oops, I also forgot, what if you equip with a unique piece of equipment
> that another of your vampires already controls?....

The he gets the equipment, which becomes contested as normal.
During your next untap (if you still control both minions),
you must pay to contest or choose to yield each copy of the
contested card in turn. If you yield all but one (a standard
choice), the you must pay 1 pool to contest the one copy you
wish to keep and burn the rest. Then, on your *following*
untap phase, you turn the equipment face up.
